status: read-only diagnostic; no candidate or adoption change

method.graph: All traversable cells with the six public hex neighbors; edge time and fuel use the departure cell and that run/day actual traffic. Terrain 0=(2,1), terrain 1=([1,2,4][traffic],2), terrain 2=(3,2); terrain 3 blocked.
method.withoutRefill: Dijkstra state (cell,fuel-used), reject cumulative fuel above that collector initial fuel; earliest arrival over all remaining labels.
method.collection: Arrival at or before final step is allowed; positive stock target is unvisited in the actual C010 plan. Extra time can be filled with one wait.
method.validation: All 16 replay days: every new move reservation neighbor/duration/fuelCost/arrival, every frame fuel balance, daily collection count and daily score delta. Every witness edge and cumulative time/fuel verified.
method.notSolved: No joint replanning or supplier-route search; reachability witnesses are only single-car target visits, and do not prove preserving other brands/balls/next-day position.

terminal.otherTerms: remaining fuel, supplier reach fuel deficit, low-fuel penalty, route completion time, incomplete-route/meeting penalties

objectiveReadback.rolloutEligible: limit >= 3500 ms and another day exists; actual entry additionally depends on remaining budget and a valid simulated day
objectiveReadback.interpretation: Primary raw does not prefer losing one daily brand for a few balls. However route/end-state penalties and next-day rollout are not a lexicographic current-day score. These different-start-state replays do not establish that a feasible all-brand candidate was generated and rejected, nor that search failed to find one.

logEvidenceScope.v1CapturedCoordinatorLogScope: final seed 11 session only, not seed 6
logEvidenceScope.retainedWorkerDiagnosticRows: participation/cross-elite counters; not a complete alternative-solution list or its objective decomposition
logEvidenceScope.conclusion: Cannot distinguish intentional objective tradeoff from ungenerated better candidate using the inspected replay/log records. No remote log read was performed.

conclusions: The single daily-brand deficit occurs on day 3, brand 10, cell 194. C010 leaves all 3 stock; D0 collects at step 32 using agent 2.

C010 agents 2 and 3 can independently reach that store from the actual day-3 start and actual traffic without any refill, in 28/24 steps and 19/15 fuel. The start-state/traffic/fuel constraints alone do not make brand 10 impossible.
The chosen C010 routes visit other brands; preserving all their other brands while adding brand 10 is unproved.
D0 day-3 state and traffic differ. This is not a same-state solver A/B, and does not establish a cross-elite causal effect.
The inspected records do not distinguish an objective tradeoff from failure to discover a better joint candidate.
